title: Sudden mastery of Morse code under threat of being sent to Vietnam

tellings.quote: Vietnam so I passed 10 12 15 20 uh 15 18 22 that day in like two hours something popped in my head

plain: In the 1960s, a former Army intelligence soldier named Joe McMoneagle says, he was struggling with Morse code at an Army intelligence school and was told he would be sent to Vietnam if he failed, and that same day, in about two hours, he passed speed test after speed test, from 10 up to 22 words a minute, because "something popped in my head." McMoneagle tells Michels this from his own life, as an early sign of an unusual ability of mind.
